details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept that beacons host metadata to a callback host at install time. Its package.json declares a postinstall hook running "node beacon.cjs", and beacon.cjs sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with the header x-beacon-package set to the package name. The JSON body contains only the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the current working directory, the npm/node user agent and the protocol. index.js re-fires the same beacon when the module is imported, and exports a Proxy that returns no-op functions for every property so that a bundler importing the name does not crash. No environment variables, credentials, tokens, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted; the only network destination is the single hardcoded callback address above.
